entries.title: Co-author abstract, session H091 (Integrative Approaches to Urban Flooding)
entries.detail: “A Deep Learning Surrogate of a HEC-RAS 2D Model for Urban Flood Forecasting in the Kathmandu Valley, Nepal”. Trained a GRU surrogate of a calibrated HEC-RAS 2D model on 244 synthetic flood events; achieved an overall R² of 0.947 and mean NSE above 0.88 at a 3-hour lead time.
